findings.summary: Headless/generated capability metadata declares failures absent from the actual classifySourceUnit Confect contract.
findings.details: The public generated docs and headless registry say classifySourceUnit can raise ReviewForbidden, StaleGeneration, and DuplicateEffect, but the actual classifySourceUnit spec omits those typed errors and the implementation only performs model-output validation before returning. Those review/commit failures belong to the sourceClassification workflow boundary, so this mismatch makes the capability API contract inconsistent for headless/workflow consumers.
